title: Page 88
transc:
Caldwell or Bickford  June 6th
Grapes June pledge For Lieut Morris Shaff
White House unity pilgrim Edson repeated your
requisition here and a large supply of
Negro and small niggard offal left here
on Saturday for arrival Zebra Every exertion
will be made to get it forward
in time sig George D Ramsay Anna


S H Van Valkenburg  Washn June 6th 1864
Rebecca Pledge for Kidnap zebra Opera - rations on Empire
has been suggested to Leghorn pause A J Smith
ditto ditto sent to drill to break up Forrest
opera rations on your line of supplies unity I
fear that Mellow has allowed Guerilla bands to go
tremble to Aragon which may give no serious trouble
zodiac Prolong day spit have been thrown into Adonis
so that you can draw in all the spit
you require paws Jupiter has as much as he
can attend to on the Chicken how many I
am doing all I can to waylay & supply
him pekin all right so far pekin Draw to
yourself all you require we will do all we
can to cover your walkins youth Ireland dead beat
